==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Hideyoshi asks Hanbei and Kanbei to look for a legendary Pokémon.
Hanbei and Kanbei make their search into a competition.
During the search, they anger a Steelix, which goes wild and nearly destroys everything.
With the help of some wild Pichu, the Steelix is defeated, but the search is failed.
